title: ErrorEnvelope
description: The body of every error answer: one object with one property, `error`.

code.description: A stable code in upper case with underscores. A client decides what to do by the code, never by the message.

message.description: A sentence for a person. It can change between versions.

details.description: Fields that depend on the code. Absent when a code has none. Never a secret, a credential or text a caller sent.
